text: The paper reports that the negative side is believed to contribute to the performance improvement in MAD: on complex tasks the affirmative side tends to make mistakes that should be corrected by the opposing side to achieve improvements. For debaters of different LLMs, the judge shows a preference for the side with the same LLM as the backbone, which the authors read as indicating that LLMs might not be a fair judge when different LLMs are used.
title: Judge prefers side sharing its backbone LLM; negative side believed to aid MAD
